metadata.title: Tool Platform
metadata.description: A plugin-based tool platform with Manifest, categories, search, and dynamic routing.

layout.sidebarDescription: A browser workstation for plugin-based tools, focused on Phase One capabilities.
layout.footerFocus: Phase focus: platform skeleton, Manifest, dynamic routing, categories & search.

home.subtitle: Phase one skeleton of Browser Tool OS — get tool entries, categories, and search working first.
home.heroTitle: Treat tools as plugins, not ordinary pages.
home.heroDescription: The current implementation focuses on platform skeleton, Manifest auto-registration, dynamic tool routing, category system, search system, and `simple` tool examples. Worker / WASM / AI Runtime support will follow.
home.quickToolsDescription: The homepage prioritizes direct tool entries over marketing copy.

categoryPanel.title: Categories
categoryPanel.description: Tools organized by recommended categories with room for future expansion.

search.title: Search Tools
search.subtitle: Search by tool name, category, tags, and description.
search.placeholder: Enter tool name, tag, or category, e.g. json / frontend / api
search.emptyDescription: Try searching by tag or category, e.g. `formatter`, `frontend`, `encoding`.

searchPage.subtitle: Search is a core entry point — this page provides the full search experience.

categoryPage.subtitle: Narrow the list by tool name, tags, runtime, or description within this category.
categoryPage.searchPlaceholder: Search name, tags, or runtime in {category}
categoryPage.emptyCategory: No tools in this category yet
categoryPage.emptyFilteredDescription: Try a different keyword, such as tool name, tag, or runtime type.
categoryPage.emptyCategoryDescription: The category system is in place — tools will appear here as they are registered.

toolPage.subtitle: Dynamic tool routing from the auto-generated Tool Registry.
toolPage.workspaceLayout: Workspace structure emphasizing input, processing, and output areas.
toolPage.lifecycle: Tools register first, then appear in categories, search, and dynamic tool pages.
toolPage.runtimeWorker: Heavy tools run off the main thread via runtime manager, Worker RPC, and OPFS storage.

toolLoader.loadError: Tool component not registered or failed to load.

notFound.title: 404 — Page Not Found
notFound.description: Check if the slug exists, or go back to the homepage to see registered tools.

media-tools.label: Media Tools

text-tools.label: Text Tools
text-tools.description: Text encoding, conversion, inspection, diffing, Markdown, regex, and bulk text handling.

data-tools.label: Data Tools

office-tools.label: Office Tools

webmaster-tools.label: Webmaster Tools
webmaster-tools.description: DNS, HTTP, ports, CIDR, headers, cookies, HAR, and website diagnostics.

learning-tools.label: Learning Tools
learning-tools.description: Study planning, examples, knowledge checks, fact-checking, and practice material prep.

calculator-tools.label: Calculator Tools
calculator-tools.description: Percentages, units, ratios, bases, time, costs, and resource conversion calculators.

social-tools.label: Social Tools
social-tools.description: Social previews, link parameters, image cards, captions, and platform assets.

ecommerce-tools.label: Ecommerce Tools
ecommerce-tools.description: Ecommerce copy, product data, conversion tracking, privacy compliance, and operations.

productivity-tools.label: Productivity Tools
productivity-tools.description: Productivity, automation, notification testing, checklist generation, and workflow helpers.

entertainment-tools.label: Entertainment Tools
entertainment-tools.description: Light creative work, random content, and casual interaction tools.

discovery-tools.label: Discovery Tools
discovery-tools.description: Tool directories, resource navigation, site indexes, discovery entry points, and collections.
